title: Let the Guru's word rein the mind
summary: The mind is an elephant until the Guru's Shabad becomes its true mark and rein. Trust begins when cleverness stops pretending to govern the soul.
takeaway: Let the Guru's Shabad hold the mind cleverness cannot govern.
lifeApplication: Before you answer from image or strategy, choose one line of Shabad and let it take the first pull on the mind.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's Shabad disciplines the wild mind and gives honor that cleverness cannot win.
source.lifeApplication: At the threshold, let one line hold the mind before image does.
